title: Halting detection with one additional decay power per time derivative
exact_target: At fixed positive computable viscosity, can every machine and input be effectively encoded into smooth mean-zero forcing and a unique zero-data global smooth Navier–Stokes flow on $T^3$, both obeying $||partial_t^j$ $D_x^\alpha $ $field(t)||_infinity\leq C_{j,\alpha }(1+t)^{-1-j}$, while one fixed particle enters one fixed strip exactly on halting? Permit either a zero-pressure force or its divergence-free projection with unchanged velocity.
